target: sign of TWII same-day close versus same-day open
decision_time: after the completed TX night session and before the TWII cash open

causal_policy.night_data: target-date session ending no later than 05:00
causal_policy.cash_data: shifted one completed TWII cash session
causal_policy.finmind_cash_institutional: shifted one completed TWII cash session
causal_policy.finmind_margin: shifted one completed TWII cash session
causal_policy.normalization: past-only rolling statistics or training-only statistics

variants.pulse_control: completed night aggregate/path plus lagged cash state
variants.pulse_plus_lagged_constitution: pulse control plus lagged cash-institution and margin state

strong_baselines: always up on identical selected dates
completed night-spread sign on identical selected dates
prior completed cash intraday sign on identical selected dates
pulse-only control on common selected dates
amendment_policy: Any later code, feature, hyperparameter or gate change creates a new experiment id and cannot alter v1 conclusions.
